label_policy: Retain original independent human labels; score abstention as incorrect classification but not false definitive evidence.
limitation: Open-world relation/profession nonexclusivity and evidence-subset sufficiency need independent adjudication. Do not tune or relabel these holdouts after observing outcomes.
initial_mlp_failure: Development P95 higher than standalone Gemini; candidate screened with development-only replay and frozen before confirmation.
precision_route_failure: Fresh confirmation P95 31.7% higher despite token-cost and median reductions; no general latency win.
compact_failure: Every supplemental case fell back to Gemini; no model calls avoided. Two-question accuracy only 50% for both. No production promotion.
unmeasured: Grounded search, full agent tool loop, all-in invoiced cost, current primary-record evaluation, central S3 economics, independent citation entailment adjudication.
